svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1068 commits across five public projects, 74 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-07-28 through 2026-10-19 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-19T01:52:38.709Z.
